name: Card
intent: One item in a grid or list of options people compare and pick, like a proposal line, product or plan: title, details, a price and a status note, with an optional image and a select checkbox.
usage: Use Card for items people scan side by side and often pick from. It is one component: pass the parts you need as props; every part is optional (header, badge, overline, title, description, amount, message, image, footer). The header row holds a badge and an overline, like a request code. description is two lines at most. amount is the price or key number. message is a short status line with an icon, colored by messageIntent. image shows a photo tile at the top right, or icon an icon tile. selectable adds a footer checkbox; clicking anywhere on the card toggles it, and the selected card turns blue. disabled greys the card out. href or onClick make the card open what it shows, like an account in a card view of a list: the title becomes the one link, its hit area covers the whole card, hover lifts the card and keyboard focus rings it. A card either opens something or is picked, not both. Lay cards out with the layout grid classes. actions and menu put the record's actions at the end of the footer, beside the checkbox: the ones it is used for as icon buttons, the rest behind More. Give a Card the same actions as the record's Table row and ListView row, so switching views never changes what can be done. See contracts/card.json for the full contract.

title.note: The item name, an h3. Two lines at most. Without it, the overline (or else the description) names the card and its checkbox.

overline.note: A short line in the header row, like Req 6787686.

badge.note: A kit Badge at the start of the header row.

description.note: Body text, cut off after two lines.

amount.note: The price or key number, like $1,200.00.

message.note: A short status line under the text, like In stock or Needs approval.

messageIntent.note: The message's icon and color: success a check, warning a triangle, danger an error mark, info an i.

image.note: Photo URL for the 72 tile at the top right.

imageAlt.note: Describes the photo. Leave it out when the photo only repeats the title.

icon.note: Material Symbols name for the 72 tile when there is no image, white on brand.

selectable.note: Adds the footer checkbox, named Select plus the title. Clicking anywhere on the card toggles it.

disabled.note: Greys the card out and disables its checkbox.

href.note: Where the card goes, like the record it shows. The title becomes the link and the whole card is its click target. Leave it out with selectable.

onClick.note: Opens what the card shows in place, like switching the page to that record. Without href the title is a button that runs it; with href it runs before the link opens. Ignored when selectable or disabled.

actions.itemShape: { id: string; label: string; icon: string }
actions.note: Icon buttons at the end of the footer, named by the action and the card. Two at most.

menu.note: The rest of the record's actions, behind one More button after the icon buttons.

onAction.note: Called with the action's id when an action button or More menu item is picked.

useWhen: Proposal lines, products or plans people compare and pick, in a grid or a list.
Items that each need a title, a few details, a price and a status at a glance.
A card view of records where clicking a card opens that record: pass href or onClick.
doNot: Do not build a card from a div with a border, or add a ProductCard, ProposalCard or CardFooter. Use Card.
Do not use it for page sections. Use Section.
Do not use it for key numbers. Use Scoreboard.
Do not put rows of records in cards when people need to sort or compare columns. Use Table.
Do not make a card both selectable and open a record. Pick one: selectable for choosing, href or onClick for opening.
Do not put a Link or Button inside a card to open it. Pass href or onClick.
Do not give a record different actions in its Card, its Table row and its ListView row.
a11y: The title is an h3 that names the card. Without a title, the card and its checkbox are named by the overline, or else the description.
When selectable, the footer Checkbox is the control, named Select plus the title. Clicking the card is a pointer shortcut for it; keyboard users tab to the Checkbox.
The message icon is decorative; the message text says what it means.
The image uses imageAlt, or is decorative without it. The icon tile is decorative.

With href or onClick the title is a real link (or a button without href), named by the title or else the overline; its hit area stretches over the card, so the card is one tab stop, and focus shows a ring round the card.
Action buttons are named by the action and the card, like Send INV-4471; the More button is named More actions for the card.
snippet:
<Card
  badge="New"
  overline="Req 6787686"
  title="Alpha Logic wireless ergonomic mouse"
  description="Rechargeable, 6 buttons, works with Windows and macOS."
  amount="$49.00"
  message="In stock"
  icon="mouse"
  selectable
/>

examples.title: Selectable
examples.usage: Click anywhere on a card to pick it; the checkbox follows and the picked card turns blue.

props.title: Alpha Logic wireless ergonomic mouse
props.description: Rechargeable, 6 buttons and a thumb rest. Works with Windows and macOS over Bluetooth or the USB receiver.

props.title: Keystone low-profile keyboard
props.description: Quiet scissor keys, backlit, with a numeric pad.

examples.title: Actions
examples.usage: A record's actions in the footer: Send and Download as icon buttons, the rest behind More. The same actions as its Table row and ListView row.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.usage: A card people can't pick right now: greyed out, checkbox off.

props.title: Beacon USB-C dock
props.description: No longer offered on new proposals.

examples.title: Without title
examples.usage: No title: the header row, description and amount carry the card. The overline names it for screen readers.

props.description: Two monitors and stands for the new design team, delivered to the Berlin office.

examples.title: Plain
examples.usage: Without selectable, the card only shows. Leave out the parts you don't need.

props.title: Annual support plan
props.description: Priority email and phone support, with a named account manager.

examples.title: Opens a record
examples.usage: href makes the whole card a link to what it shows; hover the card, or tab to it and press Enter.
